summary: Essentially implementable, since it mostly delegates to ordinary Git and ADR 0012. The only gap is whether Kyyn itself pushes or reports remote publication status.

questions.text: Does any Kyyn operation push or report remote/upstream status, or is remote publication entirely the user's own git push?
questions.reason: Reporting remote status needs a push or ahead/behind Git operation and a separate result type. ADR 0013 says 'Report local acceptance and remote publication separately', while ADR 0012 says 'Push rejection ... belong[s] to the user/agent's ordinary Git workflow' and ADR 0018 has no push verb.
